parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no documented border/document friction, no facility ban, no custody-placement rule, and no trans-specific violence data — so no known traveler-facing exposure and no universal-exposure measure. The 2019 same-sex offence was repealed in 2020 and is a sexuality-law fact, not trans law; the constitutional marriage definition is an LGB/tangential signal. Against that: absent legal gender recognition and absent GI anti-discrimination protection are resident-facing gaps / climate signals only, weighted lightly. What keeps this below the acceptance-with-protections tier is the thin positive record — no documented acceptance, no working remedy — plus single-source, uncorroborated reports that individual harassment is common and occasional police use of 'breaches of modesty' charges against gender-nonconforming presentation (described as not widespread, state-sponsored harassment absent). Extrapolating from legality plus weak rule-of-law/military governance and an unprotective institutional climate: elevated, upper end.
